Experian Interview Experience for the role Data Engineer(3 yrs+ experiene)

1. What is difference of mapreduce and spark
2. Why spark without using inmemory computation is 10x faster than mapreduce
3. Spark is written in scala , how the code written in pyspark is getting executed
4. What is the task
5. Difference of dataset and dataframe
6. Given below identify the dataset and dataframe:
 Dataset<Row> 
 Dataset<Employee>
 Dataset<dept>
7. Given the below identify the transformations and actions
 filter, reducebykey, reduce, read, write, collect 
8. Where glue catalog is stored.
9. If there is any data from s3 glacier , how to retrieve
10. While using athena if any one of the data is moved to glacier , will the data is visible here

ai_analysis.summary: This is an incomplete list of interview questions attributed to an Experian Data Engineer interview for candidates with 3+ years of experience. It covers MapReduce and Spark, Spark performance and execution, PySpark, Scala, tasks, Datasets, DataFrames, transformations and actions, Glue Catalog storage, S3 Glacier retrieval, and Athena visibility. The post provides no answers to the questions and ends with promotional text and a truncation marker.
